description: Eight outputs at fixed voltages, each a commonly occurring irrational number.

outputs.text: A steady voltage of the square root of one half, 0.70711V.
A steady voltage of the square root of two, 1.41421V.
A steady voltage of the square root of three, 1.73205V.
A steady voltage of the square root of five, 2.23607V.
A steady voltage of the square root of seven, 2.64575V.

menu: Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
